comment: Extra legs the local combined runner and the wave4f driver load beyond their own leg lists, so a local measurement sees the gated sources CI measures. ci.yml stays the authority for CI. Producers are CI jobs run as-is (their lcov goes to COV_OUT). Suites are single test files for a focused run; every one is also loaded by a CI producer. src/__tests__/combined-runner-legs.test.ts guards drift.

producers.comment: The whole coverage host set in one shard: src, the extension packages, factory-sdk, worker, extensions, docs/extensions/examples, the scoped web bun files and scripts.

The bun legs of legs-only mode: sdk, harness-client, suggest, ai-kit, providers, api-client, empty-node-shim, worker and web-utility. The Web Vitest and Python legs are not in this mode; the runner has its own.
web/src/lib/server/security sources through the bun-only security suites.
packages/@ezcorp/factory-orchestrator under the pinned Temporal test server (needs FACTORY_TEMPORAL_TEST_SERVER).

localOnlyProducers.reason: No registry holds the image: pinned.json pins localhost/ezcorp-factory-python-data by a manifest digest built with podman 5.8.2, which CI cannot pull or reproduce.
localOnlyProducers.decision: User decision (coordinator ruling 2026-09-27 16:36Z): publish the image by digest to the project's registry, point pinned.json at it, then run this producer in a db-postgres.yml storage job and move this entry to producers.
localOnlyProducers.comment: CI GAP: no workflow runs this producer, so its real-PostgreSQL leg runs in no CI job. Needs podman, the pinned PyArrow image, FACTORY_TEST_POSTGRES_URL and EZCORP_FACTORY_STORAGE_SECRETS_DIR.

suites.comment: The factory runner readiness check that ci.yml runs.
The native runner through the factory execution path.
The one-hop provider bridge for runner attempts.
The mock LLM store; runs from web/, so its lcov SF paths need the web/ prefix.
